_meta.name: English
accounts.addHint: Another Claude Code configuration directory. It is made if it is not there yet.
accounts.addWhere: Where its configuration lives — ~/.claude4, for instance.
accounts.label: name
accounts.removeHead: take it out of the list?
accounts.removeKeeps: the directory stays, with everything in it
accounts.removeTip: Take it out of this list. The directory and everything in it stays.
accounts.renameTip: Call it something else. What sessions were recorded under does not change.
agents.copyMade: A copy of your own was made. It applies from now on instead of the built-in one.
agents.deleteTip: Delete this profile of your own — built-in ones stay
agents.explain: A profile teaches plxr to recognise a CLI: which command it is, when it is waiting, when it is working. The built-in ones live in the app; your own go to ~/.plxr/agents and survive every update.
agents.fieldBlocked: Waiting for you when the screen says
agents.fieldBlockedHint: One phrase per line. The questions the CLI asks — the ones you have to answer.
agents.fieldMatchHint: One command per line. "claude" also matches "claude --resume".
agents.fieldQuietHint: After this many seconds without new output, the state on the right applies.
agents.fieldWorkingHint: One phrase per line. Anything that shows it is still going.
agents.nameAsk: What is the command called? aider, codex, cursor …
agents.newTip: Start a profile of your own — from a filled template, not an empty page
agents.noneRunning: No running session matches it yet — it takes effect as soon as one does.
agents.originBuiltIn: Built in. Saving makes a copy of your own — the original stays.
agents.originNew: New. It is created when you save.
agents.originOwn: Your own profile. It lives with you and survives every update.
agents.rawTitle: The file as it would be saved
agents.saved: {name} saved — takes effect on the next status update
agents.tryBlocked: Counts as "waiting for you" — because of: {rule}
agents.tryMatch: Recognised as this CLI — because of: {rule}
agents.tryNothing: No rule matches. After the quiet time the setting above decides.

archive.terminalsTip: Search everything that was ever on a terminal
brake.partial: {done} of {total} halted — the rest could not be stopped
empty.agents: claude · codex · opencode · aider · gemini · cursor
empty.explain: Use + NEW to start a CLI in a terminal of its own. It keeps running when you close this window.
empty.hook: Claude Code is not reporting its state yet — settings → agents → ATTACH. Without it a tile only knows what stands on the screen.

file.discardHint: The changes to {name} will be lost.
file.nothingHere: There is nothing here that could be shown.
files.deleteTip: Delete the selected entry for good

files.newFileTip: New file in the selected folder
files.newFolderTip: New folder in the selected folder
files.revealTip: Show it where this system shows files

header.brakeTip: Pause every session at once — nothing is lost, they carry on where they stopped

keys.workbench: Workbench — the console inside the window
keys.workshop: Workshop — write CSS against the running window

marks.noneHint: A mark is taken before every instruction — but only inside a git repository.
marks.noneHookHint: A mark is taken before every instruction — but only once Claude Code reports its state: settings → agents → ATTACH.
marks.openTip: A snapshot before every instruction — roll back single files
marks.rollBackAsk: Put {path} back the way it stood before this instruction? Everything else stays.
marks.title: Marks
meter.hint: Frames per second in the corner, with the two settings that cost the compositor most. Turn one off and watch the number.
new.collision: {name} already runs here. Two agents in one folder edit the same files without knowing about each other.
new.directoryPlaceholder: Type a few letters and pick
new.title: new session

notify.title: notifications
notify.tryTip: Hearing it is the only way to choose it
pace.tooltip:
Last hour extrapolated: {hour} tokens
In the last five hours: {window5h}
{active} sessions spent something in the last hour.

player.title: Playback
ports.empty: No local process holds a port right now.
ports.noneHint: No process is listening on a TCP port right now. Forgotten dev servers show up here — the ones that block the next start.

queue.tip: Line instructions up instead of sending them at once
rules.empty: Nothing in this folder or above it adds instructions for the agent.

rules.nFiles.other: {n} files apply here · as it stands now, not as it stood then

{name} was still running when plxr last stopped.
{cwd}

session.splitNone: There is no second session to place alongside.

settings.checkFailed: could not reach the release page
settings.fromSource: built from source, so it will not replace itself
settings.importHint: A theme is one JSON file: a skin plus a palette.
settings.langHint: The window is reloaded so every view speaks it.

settings.phosphorPick: Phosphor colour: across for saturation, down for brightness
settings.resetTip: Back to the colours of the theme — your changes are lost
settings.saveTip: Save the colours as a theme of your own
settings.themeHint: Changes take effect at once. Saving creates a theme of your own.
settings.title: settings
split.title: which session alongside?

style.seethroughTip: Frosted glass: what is behind the window shows through, blurred
style.tint: how much colour is in the glass
templates.empty: Start the sessions you want, then save the current set below.
templates.explain: A template opens several sessions at once — the same directories, accounts and commands as when it was saved.
templates.nameAsk: What should the template be called?
templates.noneHint: "Save current set" turns the sessions open right now into a template.
templates.nothingToSave: No session is running that could be captured.

templates.saveAskOne: {n} running session will be captured: directory, command and account.
templates.title: templates
theme.deleteTip: Delete this theme of your own — the built-in ones stay
theme.nameAsk: Under what name? Lower case letters and hyphens.
theme.saved: "{name}" is in the list now and lives under ~/.plxr/themes.
tile.crashedHint: plxr stopped unexpectedly — a click picks the conversation back up
tile.forgetTip: Take it off the board. The transcript stays in the archive.
tile.resumeTip: Carry on where this left off, in place of this one
